caption: Each 2×2 window of the 4×4 input is reduced to its largest value; the four maxima form the 2×2 output. Notice that the windows do not overlap because stride equals pool size.

spec.title: Max pooling 2×2 stride 2
spec.aria: A 4 by 4 input grid with the four window maxima marked, and the 2 by 2 max-pooled output.
